# acme-tool

Formats widgets from the command line.

## Contents

- [Installation](#installation)
- [Usage](#usage)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Demo](#demo)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g acme-tool
```

From source:

```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

## Usage

```bash
acme --help
```

## Configuration

| Variable | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| `ACME_TOKEN` | `.env.example` |
| `ACME_API_URL` | `.env.example` |

## Demo

```console
$ acme --help

```
